description.en: A popular Chinese meal in which meat, vegetables, tofu, and other ingredients are cooked in a simmering pot of broth at the table. Sichuan-style hot pot is known for its spicy broth.
description.ja: 肉、野菜、豆腐などを食卓の鍋で煮ながら食べる、中国で人気の料理です。四川風の火鍋は辛いスープで知られています。

ingredients.en: Broth, thinly sliced meat, leafy vegetables, mushrooms, tofu, noodles, chili peppers, and dipping sauce.
ingredients.ja: スープ、薄切り肉、葉物野菜、きのこ、豆腐、麺、唐辛子、つけだれ。

preparation.en: Bring the broth to a boil in a pot. Add chili peppers and other seasonings if desired. Cook the meat, vegetables, tofu, and noodles in the simmering broth, then dip them in sauce before eating.
preparation.ja: 鍋でスープを沸騰させます。好みに応じて唐辛子や調味料を加えます。肉、野菜、豆腐、麺をスープで煮て、たれにつけて食べます。
